physical_validation.scope: Four pure-0/2 patterns, including two blocked alternating controls; m4 L12 and m2 L6; theta0,4,7,Inf and beta0,1,2. Finite-time reference is full real-space exact exp(-0.25H) plus QR, cross-checked at step0.125. Infinite-time reference is a separate real-space energy-block/nullspace spectral-support construction, not long QR evolution. Full C, three S2 and weighted D are compared; blocked accessible limits retain positive excitation energy and are never labeled ground states. No scaling claim.

analysis_validation.method: Independent mpmath 80-digit rectangular QR from raw decimal D values; no production fit helper

max_fit_error_scope: Maximum absolute error of the logarithmic coefficient against independent 80-digit QR
scope: Frozen plan and complete observations; all four class-2 masks, cut compatibility, D identity, numerical orbital/entropy diagnostics, physical GS-accessibility flags including blocked accessible excited-state limits; per-row ledger and complete run/code/plan provenance; independent small real-space reference for all 48 states, with strict spectral-support Inf construction; 80-digit limit/time fits, primary anchors and raw secants. Blocked states are never certified as ground states or ground-state corner-coefficient estimates. Passing numerical checks is not proof of asymptotic logarithmic scaling.
